purpose: Phase-7C net immune-mediated tumour-loss potential. Derived from explicit component contributions (NK + CD8 cytotoxic potential, macrophage tumour-opposing contribution, immune visibility, antigen-presentation effectiveness, helper support) reduced by suppression / exhaustion / checkpoint pressure / immune escape. Phase 7C does NOT directly mutate tumour population; it PUBLISHES a proposed immune-mediated tumour-loss modifier that the population/response engine may consume. Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1].

outputs.effective_modifier: realized proposed tumour-loss modifier after suppression/escape [0,1]

coefficient_policy.source: availability-aware aggregation of the component immune metrics (predicted)
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: effective_modifier is a PROPOSED loss request, applied by a downstream engine once - never applied twice (as direct death AND an identical response modifier).
coefficient_policy.limitations: No absolute tumour-cell kill count or rate (NOT_REPORTED).

double_counting_rules.loss_applied_once: the proposed immune-mediated tumour-loss modifier is consumed by exactly one downstream engine; it is not both a direct population death and an identical response modifier.
